ProgramUnit.Name: DUPLI_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* This Procedure Checks Out Duplicate Records while entering...
 ABO LABEL 30-Jan-97 
*/
PROCEDURE dupli_check IS
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 temp_v_item_name varchar2(50); 
 temp_v_abo_label varchar2(5);
 temp_v_unit_scheme_type varchar2(1);
 temp_c_rec_no VARCHAR2(4);
 temp_tested_abo varchar2(5); 
 BEGIN
 temp_v_item_name := :system.cursor_item;
 temp_v_abo_label := :abo_label;
 temp_v_unit_scheme_type := :unit_scheme_type;
 temp_tested_abo := :tested_abo_code;
 temp_c_rec_no := :system.trigger_record;
 go_record('1');
 WHILE :system.last_record = 'FALSE'
 LOOP
 IF :abo_label = temp_v_abo_label AND
 :system.trigger_record != temp_c_rec_no AND
 :unit_scheme_type = temp_v_unit_scheme_type AND
 :tested_abo_code = temp_tested_abo
 THEN
 first_record;
 go_record(temp_c_rec_no);
 go_item(temp_v_item_name);
 show_error('0069');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 down;
 END LOOP;
 first_record;
 go_record(temp_c_rec_no);
 go_item(temp_v_item_name);
 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUPLI_PRIMARY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dupli_primary IS
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 temp_v_item_name varchar2(50);
 temp_v_tested_abo_code varchar2(5);
 temp_v_unit_scheme_type varchar2(1);
 temp_v_identifier_code varchar2(5);
 temp_v_abo_label varchar2(4);
 temp_c_rec_no VARCHAR2(4);

BEGIN
 temp_v_item_name := :system.cursor_item;
 temp_v_tested_abo_code := :tested_abo_code;
 temp_v_unit_scheme_type := :unit_scheme_type;
 temp_v_identifier_code := :identifier_code;
 temp_v_abo_label := :abo_label;
 temp_c_rec_no := :system.trigger_record;
 go_record('1');
 WHILE :system.last_record = 'FALSE'
 LOOP
 IF :tested_abo_code = temp_v_tested_abo_code
 AND :system.trigger_record != temp_c_rec_no
 AND :unit_scheme_type = temp_v_unit_scheme_type
 AND :identifier_code = temp_v_identifier_code
 AND :abo_label = temp_v_abo_label 
 THEN
 first_record;
 go_record(temp_c_rec_no);
 go_item(temp_v_item_name);
 show_error('0069');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 down;
 END LOOP;
 first_record; 
 go_record(temp_c_rec_no);
 go_item(temp_v_item_name);
END;
END;
